stanzas.sanskrit:
रमाजाने जाने यदिह तव भक्तेषु विभवो
न सद्यः सम्पद्यस्तदिह मदकृत्त्वादशमिनाम् ।
प्रशान्तिं कृत्वैव प्रदिशसि ततः काममखिलं
प्रशान्तेषु क्षिप्रं न खलु भवदीये च्युतिकथा ॥ ८९-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan devotees are not easily blessed in this world. Wealth increases arrogance and madness. So HE makes them humble and get a balanced state of mind before offering prosperity. There is no question of Bhagwan devotee's downfall.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ramājāne jāne yadiha tava bhakteṣu vibhavo
na sadyaḥ sampadyastadiha madakṛttvādaśaminām |
praśāntiṃ kṛtvaiva pradiśasi tataḥ kāmamakhilaṃ
praśānteṣu kṣipraṃ na khalu bhavadīye cyutikathā || 89-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
सद्यः प्रसादरुषितान् विधिशङ्करादीन्
केचिद्विभो निजगुणानुगुणं भजन्तः ।
भ्रष्टा भवन्ति बत कष्टमदीर्घदृष्ट्या
स्पष्टं वृकासुर उदाहरणं किलास्मिन् ॥ ८९-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: There are people who pray Brahma and Shiva who can be easily pleased and angered, according to their nature. Due to absence of long standing goal, they are not successful in this attempt and end up angering the devatha. Vrikasuran, son of Shakuni is a best example.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sadyaḥ prasādaruṣitān vidhiśaṅkarādīn
kecidvibho nijaguṇānuguṇaṃ bhajantaḥ |
bhraṣṭā bhavanti bata kaṣṭamadīrghadṛṣṭyā
spaṣṭaṃ vṛkāsura udāharaṇaṃ kilāsmin || 89-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
शकुनिजः स तु नारदमेकदा
त्वरिततोषमपृच्छदधीश्वरम् ।
स च दिदेश गिरीशमुपासितुं
न तु भवन्तमबन्धुमसाधुषु ॥ ८९-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Once, Vrikasuran enquired Naradha as to which God will give darshan easily on prayers. Naradha suggested praying to Lord Shiva as Krishna Bhagwan is never happy with people possessing bad virtues.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
śakunijaḥ sa tu nāradamekadā
tvaritatoṣamapṛcchadadhīśvaram |
sa ca dideśa girīśamupāsituṃ
na tu bhavantamabandhumasādhuṣu || 89-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तपस्तप्त्वा घोरं स खलु कुपितः सप्तमदिने
शिरश्छित्त्वा सद्यः पुरहरमुपस्थाप्य पुरतः ।
अतिक्षुद्रं रौद्रं शिरसि करदानेन निधनं
जगन्नाथाद्वव्रे भवति विमुखानां क्व शुभधीः ॥ ८९-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Vrikasuran did severe penance for seven days and on the seventh day, he tried to cut his head. Shiva gave darshan to Vrikasuran. Immediately Vrikasuran requested cruel boon, that the person on whose head he keeps his hand, that person should die. It is quite natural for non-devotees of Krishna to not possess good thoughts or actions.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tapastaptvā ghoraṃ sa khalu kupitaḥ saptamadine
śiraśchittvā sadyaḥ puraharamupasthāpya purataḥ |
atikṣudraṃ raudraṃ śirasi karadānena nidhanaṃ
jagannāthādvavre bhavati vimukhānāṃ kva śubhadhīḥ || 89-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
मोक्तारं बन्धमुक्तो हरिणपतिरिव प्राद्रवत्सोऽथ रुद्रं
दैत्याद्भीत्या स्म देवो दिशि दिशि वलते पृष्ठतो दत्तदृष्टिः ।
तूष्णीके सर्वलोके तव पदमधिरोक्ष्यन्तमुद्वीक्ष्य शर्वं
दूरादेवाग्रतस्त्वं पटुवटुवपुषा तस्थिषे दानवाय ॥ ८९-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Lord Shiva granted the boon. Immediately Vrikasuran tried to test this on Shiva himself. Shiva ran here and there to protect himself, but none in the three worlds came to his support. Finally Shiva was reaching Vaikunta. Seeing the asura running towards Vaikunta, Krishna in the guise of a clever Brahmachaari went and stood before him.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
moktāraṃ bandhamukto hariṇapatiriva prādravatso’tha rudraṃ
daityādbhītyā sma devo diśi diśi valate pṛṣṭhato dattadṛṣṭiḥ |
tūṣṇīke sarvaloke tava padamadhirokṣyantamudvīkṣya śarvaṃ
dūrādevāgratastvaṃ paṭuvaṭuvapuṣā tasthiṣe dānavāya || 89-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
भद्रं ते शाकुनेय भ्रमसि किमधुना त्वं पिशाचस्य वाचा
सन्देहश्चेन्मदुक्तौ तव किमु न करोष्यङ्गुलीमङ्ग मौलौ ।
इत्थं त्वद्वाक्यमूढः शिरसि कृतकरः सोऽपतच्छिन्नपातं
भ्रंशो ह्येवं परोपासितुरपि च गतिः शूलिनोऽपि त्वमेव ॥ ८९-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna asked Vrikasuran, why he was running here and there to test the boon when he could try on his head itself. Vrikasuran attracted by the charm of the Brahmachaari, without thinking kept his hand on his head and fell like a tree whose root was cut. Such is the fate of the people who worship other deities. Thus Krishna only protected Lord Shiva.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bhadraṃ te śākuneya bhramasi kimadhunā tvaṃ piśācasya vācā
sandehaścenmaduktau tava kimu na karoṣyaṅgulīmaṅga maulau |
itthaṃ tvadvākyamūḍhaḥ śirasi kṛtakaraḥ so’patacchinnapātaṃ
bhraṃśo hyevaṃ paropāsiturapi ca gatiḥ śūlino’pi tvameva || 89-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
भृगुं किल सरस्वतीनिकटवासिनस्तापसा-
-स्त्रिमूर्तिषु समादिशन्नधिकसत्त्वतां वेदितुम् ।
अयं पुनरनादरादुदितरुद्धरोषे विधौ
हरेऽपि च जिहिंसिषौ गिरिजया धृते त्वामगात् ॥ ८९-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Once sages living along Saraswati river got a doubt as to which God among trinities is more sattvic in nature, They sent sage Bhrigu to the three lokas on this mission. On reaching Brahma loka, Bhrigu did not pray to Brahma which angered him but then he controlled it. Next Bhrigu went to Shiva. Lord Shiva on seeing Bhrigu coming, ran towards him to hug him. Bhrigu pulled himself off which angered Shiva, however, Parvathy pacified Shiva. Then Bhrigu reached Vaikunta.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bhṛguṃ kila sarasvatīnikaṭavāsinastāpasā-
-strimūrtiṣu samādiśannadhikasattvatāṃ veditum |
ayaṃ punaranādarāduditaruddharoṣe vidhau
hare’pi ca jihiṃsiṣau girijayā dhṛte tvāmagāt || 89-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
सुप्तं रमाङ्कभुवि पङ्कजलोचनं त्वां
विप्रे विनिघ्नति पदेन मुदोत्थितस्त्वम् ।
सर्वं क्षमस्व मुनिवर्य भवेत् सदा मे
त्वत्पादचिह्नमिह भूषणमित्यवादीः ॥ ८९-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna was sleeping on Mahalakshmi's lap. Sage Bhrigu went and kicked Bhagwan on HIS chest. Krishna got up immediately, begged pardon and said the scar made by Bhrigu's kicking will remain like a jewel in HIS chest always.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
suptaṃ ramāṅkabhuvi paṅkajalocanaṃ tvāṃ
vipre vinighnati padena mudotthitastvam |
sarvaṃ kṣamasva munivarya bhavet sadā me
tvatpādacihnamiha bhūṣaṇamityavādīḥ || 89-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
निश्चित्य ते च सुदृढं त्वयि बद्धभावाः
सारस्वता मुनिवरा दधिरे विमोक्षम् ।
त्वामेवमच्युत पुनश्च्युतिदोषहीनं
सत्त्वोच्चयैकतनुमेव वयं भजामः ॥ ८९-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Sages at Saraswati river learnt about this incident through Bhrigu and concluded that Krishna is the only GOD to have sattvic virtue the most. The sages since then were completely devoted to Bhagwan and reached Moksham.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
niścitya te ca sudṛḍhaṃ tvayi baddhabhāvāḥ
sārasvatā munivarā dadhire vimokṣam |
tvāmevamacyuta punaścyutidoṣahīnaṃ
sattvoccayaikatanumeva vayaṃ bhajāmaḥ || 89-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
जगत्सृष्ट्यादौ त्वां निगमनिवहैर्वन्दिभिरिव
स्तुतं विष्णो सच्चित्परमरसनिर्द्वैतवपुषम् ।
परात्मानं भूमन् पशुपवनिताभाग्यनिवहं
परीतापश्रान्त्यै पवनपुरवासिन् परिभजे ॥ ८९-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhattathiri worshipped the Sattva form of Lord, which never had the quality of downfall from its total sattvic nature. When this universe was formed, the vedas and upanishads glorified Bhagwan. HE is the only God who is in Sat-Chit-ananda form, Advaitha form and Paramatma. Bhattathiri offered worship to Bhagwan, who is the fortune of Gopikas, to protect him from all sorrows.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
jagatsṛṣṭyādau tvāṃ nigamanivahairvandibhiriva
stutaṃ viṣṇo saccitparamarasanirdvaitavapuṣam |
parātmānaṃ bhūman paśupavanitābhāgyanivahaṃ
parītāpaśrāntyai pavanapuravāsin paribhaje || 89-10 ||
